added_claim_errors: Says the small-claims filing fee is 50 yuan: likely wrong. Small claims runs under the simple procedure, and 诉讼费用交纳办法 Art. 16 halves the fee, which usually makes it 25 yuan (judged from my own knowledge).
Details of the Henan Xinye case (about 50,000 yuan claimed, form said 'clothing', 13,000 yuan awarded including freight): a link is given, but I did not open it, so the figures are unverified.
Says writing 'iPhone 15' on the waybill fully meets the duty to disclose: overstated. Value was still not declared, so a court could still reduce the award.
Cites 民法典 第四百九十六条或第四百九十七条 for the duty to point out the format term: loose. Art. 497 makes unfair exemption clauses invalid; the duty to point out and explain is in Art. 496 alone.
Says 12305 has been merged into 12345 in some regions: no source given, unverifiable.

reasons: The two answers are almost word for word the same. Both catch the false premise in the first line, correctly explain that the Postal Law's Art. 47 triple-postage cap does not apply to express parcels (Arts. 45 and 59), cite 快递暂行条例 Art. 28, write a polite but firm reply asking for 3999 yuan, and warn that a court may cut the award. Neither cites Civil Code Arts. 832/833 or Art. 506, and neither mentions the one-year deadline for filing a complaint. A comes out slightly ahead for three reasons. It cites Art. 496 accurately, where B writes '496 or 497'. It gives the national postal complaint website (sswz.spb.gov.cn) as a second route. B instead adds an unsourced claim that 12305 has been merged into 12345 in some regions.
